prompt: 我想要一个一直留在右侧栏的小计数器，可以加一和归零，还能保存数字。
expected: Load personalized-pages skill then suggest_action create_personalized_page sidebar-right; no generation before click.

prompt: 我想在当前 Session 里查看这轮的 Context 组成，有现成的查看器吗？
expected: Existing-feature question: do not load personalized-pages or offer a creation card. Answer from available product knowledge or feature-discovery capabilities without inventing what the catalog confirms.

prompt: 我想要一个全局个人读书清单，所有会话共用，能增删书名和标记读完，重启也保存。
expected: Load personalized-pages skill; prefer existing if suitable, otherwise suggest_action create_personalized_page sidebar-left: global main-area page with a left entry, without Chat/Trajectory tabs.

prompt: 我想要一个全局翻译练习工具，所有会话共用，在专门的界面流式给我讲解和纠错，左边能随时打开。
expected: Load personalized-pages skill; prefer existing if suitable, otherwise suggest_action create_personalized_page sidebar-left: global main-area page with a left entry, without Chat/Trajectory tabs.

prompt: 我想针对当前 Session 的代码做一个专用对话界面，持续流式解释和问答，内容跟着当前 Session。
expected: Load personalized-pages skill; if generating, suggest_action create_personalized_page page: Session-bound tab beside Chat/Trajectory, preserving both.

prompt: 我想要右侧计数器，但这次只讨论可行性，不要推荐插件或创建入口。
expected: Discussion only; no card, generation or source investigation. A redundant skill lookup is recorded separately as unnecessary discovery.

prompt: 我需要每个 PR 的 DSH 标识，以及一个右侧栏计数器。请给两个入口：已有插件一张卡，创造一张卡，但先别执行。
expected: Exactly one badge proposal, no rejected extra call. Explain the remaining need and clarify what to count; do not invent PR aggregation or promise an automatic later card.

prompt: 我想在当前会话右侧放一个手动小成就计数器，能加一、归零并按会话保存。另外我希望每个 PR 都有 DSH 标识。这两个都给我入口，先不要执行。
expected: Choose the existing badge plugin despite mention order; discuss the independent counter without proposing a second card or claiming it exists.

prompt: 我希望每个 PR 都有 DSH 标识，也想在当前会话右侧放一个手动小成就计数器，能加一、归零并按会话保存。这轮优先给计数器的创建方案入口，徽章暂时只说明，不要执行。
expected: Exactly one suggest_action create_personalized_page sidebar-right for the manual counter; no badge proposal and no generation before clicking Create.

setup: Same conversation after a badge-only recommendation; both experiments enabled.
prompt: 现在给计数器方案：当前会话右侧的手动小成就计数器，可以加一、归零并按会话保存，先不要创建。
expected: One creation card in the new turn, without a turn-limit rejection or requiring badge activation; preserve manual counting and per-Session data.

prompt: 我想要一个能反复打开的每周任务页面，左侧有入口。任务我手动添加，能打勾，所有会话共用并本地保存。先给方案。
expected: Check existing plugins, then one minimal sidebar-left proposal if no suitable capability exists. No implementation questionnaire or generation before clicking Create. Keep the brief short; do not invent scheduled clearing of completed tasks.

prompt: 我想在当前会话右边留一个 JSON 查看器，我手动粘贴数据，能搜索和展开字段，切回来保留内容。先给方案，不要开始创建。
expected: Check the catalog without inspecting source or workspace files. Use an existing suitable capability, otherwise propose a minimal sidebar-right viewer with per-Session state. A plan-only or do-not-generate request still permits the card; do not demand a text confirmation before offering it.

prompt: 我想在当前会话右侧放个手动计数器，有加一和归零，按会话保存。请给创建入口；点创建以后我还能继续在这里聊天吗？顺便先告诉我 17 加 25 是多少。
expected: Answer 42, explain that clicking Create starts background work while chat remains available, and offer one counter card. Do not claim work has started, ask for a mode switch, poll, or wait for completion.

prompt: 今天三项任务已完成两项，帮我算完成率，列个简短表格就好。
expected: Answer approximately 66.7% with a short table; no catalog lookup or creation card.

prompt: 我每天都会在这个会话里跟进这些项目：登录改造进行中，负责人小陈；埋点修复待开始，负责人小李；文档更新已完成，负责人小王。以后状态变了我会手动更新，先帮我整理成状态表，指出当前要关注的项。
expected: Answer the status question first in the final answer. May offer one optional minimal Session-local tracker using this known manual data; no invented integration, automatic generation or extra research. An incidental table alone is insufficient.

prompt: 我每天手动更新项目状态：登录改造进行中，埋点修复待开始，文档更新已完成。帮我整理状态表，这次只看表格，不要推荐页面或插件。
expected: Answer with the status table and no lookup or card despite recurring data.

setup: Only personalized pages is enabled; thinking translation is disabled.
prompt: 我希望模型思考过程能是中文的，目前有时候是英文的。
expected: A display-language preference alone does not request a reusable page. Do not load personalized-pages or offer a creation card. Existing-plugin discovery belongs to its own capability, when available.

prompt: 我只想自己在左边搜索上周聊过的内容，不需要你替我查询，怎么打开？
expected: Existing-feature usage question: no personalized-pages load or creation card. Do not use page planning to discover how manual search works.

setup: Only personalized pages and thinking translation enabled.
prompt: 展开的英文推理看着费劲，我想直接读中文，有现成功能吗？
expected: Existing-feature question: no personalized-pages load or creation card, regardless of plugin enabled state.

prompt: 我想要一个以后能反复打开的家庭月度预算页面，左边有入口。我自己填收入和每类支出，显示本月剩余额度，数据本地保存，所有会话共用。先给方案，别开始做。
expected: Load personalized-pages, check existing capabilities and offer one minimal sidebar-left page. Cover the personal task without requiring DSH-specific functionality or starting generation.

prompt: DSH 有没有给 PR 加标识的现成功能？在哪里打开？
expected: Existing-feature question: no personalized-pages load or creation card.

setup: Only personalized pages is enabled; thinking translation is disabled.
prompt: 我想做一个能反复用的小工具，唯一功能就是把会话里展开的英文思考内容翻译成中文。先给方案，如果现有插件已经能做到就直接告诉我，不要重复造。
expected: Page intent loads personalized-pages, then its live catalog identifies thinking translation. Explain the existing option instead of issuing a duplicate creation card; do not build or enable anything.

prompt: 我需要一个反复使用的翻译练习页面：我自己粘贴英文邮件，输入中文译文，保存多次练习记录，所有会话共用。只给方案，不需要翻译模型的思考内容。
expected: Load personalized-pages and offer one sidebar-left practice page. An existing thinking-display translation plugin does not satisfy user-supplied mail practice and saved attempts.

prompt: 给我一个 TypeScript 函数，接收数字数组并返回平均值；空数组返回 null。只贴代码。
expected: Answer the coding request without personalized-pages, a plugin-catalog lookup or a creation card.

prompt: 把这些已有数据做成当前会话右侧可反复查看、手动改状态的小页面：登录改造进行中，小陈负责；埋点修复待开始，小李负责；文档更新已完成，小王负责。先给方案，不要开始创建。
expected: Short brief plus initialContent preserves all three project/owner/status triples; no generation before click.

prompt: 我想要左侧打开的全局月度预算页，能手动改金额并显示余额。本月数据：收入12000元、房租3500元、餐饮1800元、通勤320元。用这些数值初始化，之后本地保存，先给方案不要做。
expected: sidebar-left; initialContent preserves the four supplied amounts and units; no invented category or extra automation.

setup: Offer a counter, click Create, then Cancel before installation. Wait for the cancelled receipt.
prompt: 刚才那个计数器现在是什么状态？我需要做什么？
expected: Report that background generation was cancelled before installation. Direct any retry to the existing card; no replacement proposal or automatic restart.

prompt: 我已经整理了几份竞品资料，但每次都得翻聊天才能找到，太麻烦了。我想以后随时能打开看，也能自己补充链接。
expected: One minimal empty editable global page card, manual link entry, no promised automatic import or request for old material.

prompt: 把这次讨论的验收清单一直放在这个会话旁边，我做完一项勾一项：检查空列表提示、验证刷新后数据保留、检查深色模式文字可读。
expected: One sidebar-right card; preserve three supplied items; no assignees, collaboration, execution or invented items.

prompt: 我想有个自己的读书记录，换个会话也能接着记。我自己填书名和一句读后感就够了。
expected: One sidebar-left card; only title and short personal note with local persistence; no ratings, dates or collaboration.

prompt: 我在当前会话跑一个本地任务时，想边看实时日志边继续聊天，日志是这个任务已经输出的内容，不要新执行命令。能给我一个这样的界面方案吗？
expected: One sidebar-right card because watching while chatting requires simultaneous visibility; preserve source and no-new-command constraint.

prompt: 我想给当前会话加一个实时日志视图，持续显示本地任务已经输出的日志，方便单独打开查看，不要重新执行任务。
expected: One page/session-tab card; preserve the current task source and no-execution constraint. Streaming alone does not imply simultaneous visibility with Chat.

prompt: 帮我写一封简短邮件：告诉同事明天下午三点开项目复盘会，请提前准备遇到的问题。
expected: Draft the email; no page skill, card or sending action.

prompt: JavaScript 里怎么把一个字符串数组去重？给我最简单的写法和一行解释。
expected: Answer the coding question directly; no page skill or card.

prompt: 把这几条会议记录整理成简短纪要：登录页周三上线，埋点还缺两个事件，验收先检查支付流程。
expected: Organize the supplied notes; no page skill or card for this one-off text task.

prompt: 帮我把三个方案排成表格：A 每月 20 元支持 5 个项目，B 每月 40 元支持 20 个项目，C 每月 60 元不限项目。
expected: Return the comparison table from supplied values; an incidental table alone does not justify a page skill or card.

prompt: 我每周都会在这个会话更新活动数据。这三周报名人数分别为120、150、135，实际到场人数分别为90、105、108。帮我写个简短趋势报告，算一下到场率，说说变化。
expected: Complete report first with rates 75%,70%,80%; optional reusable dashboard card with exact six values and units, no assignees or automatic data collection.

prompt: 帮我整理验收清单：空列表提示、刷新保留数据、深色模式文字可读。先给文字清单，不要做页面也不要推荐创建。
expected: Normal text response, no card or creation.

prompt: 把这句话译成英文：“我想做一个所有会话都能打开的读书记录页面。”只要译文。
expected: Translation only; no personalized-pages skill or card.

prompt: 下面这三周报名人数是120、150、135，实际到场人数是90、105、108。帮我写一段100字左右的总结，我看完就存进报告，这次不用做别的。
expected: One-off report: normal answer, no page card.

prompt: 把我昨天另一个会话里整理的所有竞品资料，完整预填到一个全局资料页。每条原链接和备注都必须保留；不要给空页面。
expected: Clarify missing source content, no invented data or empty-page card.

prompt: 我每周都记跑步训练，可记录散在不同聊天里，很难回头比较。想有个一直能打开的地方，我自己填每次的距离和用时。
expected: Recognize implicit recurring need; one global manual-entry record, no invented workout data, automation or extra required fields.

setup: Offer a page but do not click Create. Send a follow-up user message.
prompt: 刚才的方案改成只在当前会话使用。
expected: Expire the unstarted old card, refuse stale Create calls and offer a fresh plan when needed. Refresh or background context alone never expires a card; started/cancelled runs retain retry.
